featured_reviews.name: shravya rai
featured_reviews.review_text:
My experience with Trace Remedial Therapy Centre is truely everlasting. My child was slow in speaking and was very highly active. I stay abroad and I was worried whether my child will be able to cope up with the school here and the surrounding. After lot of surfing online I came across Trace remedial centre and with its positive reviews online, I decided to fly down to India and start for the therapy sessions.
First of all I would really like to thanks all the parents who have given so much positive feedback about their childrens that gave me the confidence to approach Trace. Now I seriously know why a review is important as it can help many parents like me to find the right place for their childrens wellbeing.
My child started OT as well as speech sessions with Trace from last one and half months and I must say I have seen a remarkable improvement and stability in him. He has started forming sentences while speaking , earlier he used to say only few words. His activness is also at par and has got a good sitting tolerance and follows and understands instructions too. Big thanks to all the mentors and doctors who really put their efforts to get the desired output. I would like to thank Dr. Akansha, Payal, Samreen, Ashwini mam and special thanks to Inshiya mam who gave me the confidence to come here from abroad and take sessions with Trace.
Trace has a very good understanding of the child needs and they tailor the sessions as per the child’s requirement for their growth and improvement. Apart from the doctors/mentors guidance, they even simplify the things for the parents too,  how we can guide and tackle our kid. After every session they gave me feedback of what was done and how I can take it forward from my end too , As double the efforts from both end the results will be truely outstanding.
As I am going back now, I am bit disappointed if I could extend few more months but I am really thankful for the Trace team for their extended support and I know they will support me in future also whenever required.
Lastly I would strongly recommend Trace therapy centre to all the parents who are looking out for a better place for their kidos. Your questions will be answered and solution to your problems is definately here.
Big big thanks to Trace team, doctors , mentors and support staff all are very co-operative and professional.
Wish you luck for all your future endeavours .. keep up the good work and spread the magic of your therapies through your sessions to the child and parents🙏🏻🙏🏻
“A happy child makes a  happy family” and I know you will keep spreading endless smile and happiness.
Gratitude🙏🏻🙏🏻
A happy mom😃

featured_reviews.name: Satej J
featured_reviews.review_text: We have enrolled our Kid in Occupational and Behavioral Therapy at Trace, the former for almost 1.5 years now, the latter closing into 6 months. We both parents are very happy with the progress our kid is showing with the continual efforts of the therapists, namely Dr. Mansi (OT) and Dr.Samrin. They make extra efforts to understand what the child needs and ensure that his treatment is tailor-made to suit him the best. We are glad that we met Inshiya Madam who has been very kind and cooperative towards us. We hope this message finds the parents out there and their child benefits, the way ours is benefiting!

featured_reviews.name: habiba lakdawala
featured_reviews.review_text: I was very anxious with my childs behaviour in public and at home. As she was very aggressive and annoying at a lot of times. After hearing from an acquaintance I visited Trace Remedial cIinic in Mira Road. I was very impressed with Insiya Ma'am's knowledge and expertise in special education. She was always up-to-date on the latest research and best practices, and she was able to adapt her teaching methods to meet my child's individual needs. She was also very patient and understanding, and she always made me feel like my child was in good hands. I would highly recommend Insiya Ma'am to any parent looking for a qualified and caring special educator.

featured_reviews.name: Nida Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
My son has joined the Occupational therapy in August last year under Akansha ma'am since then I have seen a drastic improvement in him
He has issues with response and mostly zero response to strangers, use to hardly speak anything, skin oversensitivity, lack of communication with others, overly repetitive, not willing to try new things, clutophobic he was very uncomfortable around other people.
Now he has improved a lot responds to his name call, follows basic commands, can do many task independently, watches other's and is atleast try to interact with some he prefers. He has got over with most of his skin oversensitivity issues , motion issues, Strangers anxiety, teeth grinding, excessive nodding
Speech therapy -under Ashwini ma'am, after his response improved he started with speech therapy and now he is able to say alphabets, few rhymes, body parts, colours, numbers he often tries to name the object in the book. He is also able to identify and express a little more with his improved vocabulary and response.
Overall i would suggest it other parents with similar issues. It has definitely worked for my son. 👍

featured_reviews.name: Savina D'sooza
featured_reviews.review_text:
My Son is attending OT and remedial therapy at Trace remedial centre. I am very much satisfied with the therapist here. My son is taking therapy since 8 months. Seen a lot of improvement in him.

Thanks to Leena Ma'am (OT) and Inshiya Ma'am (remedial) therapist who understand our concern and started the required OT and remedial therapy. Both of them taught me some exercise and one on one activities to be taken at home. These help a lot in improving his concentration level.

I definitely recommend this clinic to child who in need of OT and Remedial therapy.
